decoded.meaning: SUBSCRIBER{} with no children: no target_path. As the payload of a routed :subscribers[] append (FWD{WRITE}) it is ADMITTED, and the producer's later writes are delivered over the frame's return route (RFC-0021 §4.D; reference/05 §0x04, RFC-0021 erratum 2026-10-08)
decoded.note: a well-formed TLV, so every codec round-trips it; the admission is behavioural and is bound in core/tests/op_resolve_test.cpp (test_routed_append_needs_no_target). The same bytes written through the local :subscribers[] field door are refused tr::schema::type_mismatch, because that door delivers to a local target and the record names none
